title: No trouble with whites at a black club: Hayes's ties to the mayor
summary: Whites came without problems because Hayes kept an orderly place and had good connections with the mayor.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Yeah. But my point was, was there any problem with the whites coming into a black establishment? No problem.

No problem. No problems at all. We'll see, Mr. Hayes, I think, at that time, was contributing to whatever quality of life that we had at that time. He had good connections with the mayor at that time. I think it was Ski Row was the mayor at that time. And prior to Ski Row, you had a... Morrison.

Mayor Morrison. It could have been Morrison, I think. It was Morrison. Mayor Morrison. And so they, the laws made no trouble for Mr. Hayes. He made sure that they wouldn't make any trouble because he kept a very unique place, very likable place. People seemed to enjoy themselves when they came here. You had to come in there well, well-groomed, and your mannerism had to be at the highest level in order to get service. He made sure that everything was above board.
